description_en: Call DescribeDcdnReport to query the data of a customized report
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnReport查询已定制的报表数据
name: DescribeDcdnReport

parameters.help_en: The domain names that you want to query. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的域名列表，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the report that you want to query. You can specify only one report ID in each call. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/270075.html operation to query report IDs
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的报表ID，每次调用仅支持传入单个报表ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/270075.html接口查询报表ID
parameters.name: report_id

parameters.help_en:
The English name of the region. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html operation to obtain the English name of a region.

If you do not specify this parameter, data in all regions is queried.

If you specify a region, data in that region is returned. You can specify multiple regions. Separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
地域英文名，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html接口获取地域英文名。

如果不传该参数，默认查询全部地域。
如果传入指定地域，则按照指定的地域获取相应数据。支持传入多个地域，多个地域用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: area

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the region is outside the Chinese mainland. Valid values:

1: a region outside the Chinese mainland.

0: the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
是否为中国内地以外的区域。取值：
1：中国内地以外的区域。
0：中国内地
parameters.name: is_overseas

parameters.help_en:
The HTTP status code. Valid values:

2xx: 2xx status codes.

3xx: 3xx status codes.

4xx: 4xx status codes.

5xx: 5xx status codes.

If you do not specify this parameter, all the preceding HTTP status codes are queried by default
parameters.help_zh:
HTTP状态码。取值：
2xx：2xx状态码。
3xx：3xx状态码。
4xx：4xx状态码。
5xx：5xx状态码。

如果不传该参数，默认查询以上全部HTTP状态码
parameters.name: http_code

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。使用UTC+0时间表示，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间。使用UTC+0时间表示，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

Content.description_en: The data of the queried report
